correctness.rationale: The proof starts from the exact renewal equation; computes the mixed Brownian resolvent and its Doob transform; uses stopped Girsanov and stochastic integration by parts to isolate e^{-dv/(2D)}. Under the tilted first-passage measure, T has mean O(r^{-1/2}), variance O(r^{-3/2}), the reference position is bounded, and the upper reflection event is exponentially rare. Conditional OU Gaussian moments on the accelerated path control the remainder uniformly on a bounded reset-velocity interval. Strict convexity establishes exact extremizers. Independently checked 8,823 finite deterministic consistency assertions, and sampled the tilted stochastic reference. The finite checks do not prove the uniform asymptotic; no independent audit has verified its analytic estimates.

value.rationale: The high-reset absorption asymptotic is a natural unresolved analytical regime for active velocity reinitialization, with a measurable propulsion-memory multiplicative factor independent of persistence/noise at leading order. It yields the unique two-point extremal velocity law at a fixed mean, a genuine distributional design classification rather than a cosmetic reformulation of a fixed-velocity monotonicity fact.
